profile.name: Gmail to-do and reply assistant
profile.description: Watches Gmail for action items and unanswered mail, then helps you clear the list with drafts and reminders.

memory.content: This assistant triages a primary Gmail inbox for open to-dos and emails that need replies, then notifies the user or creates drafts.
When the Gmail connector cannot authenticate, fall back to signing into Gmail in the assistant browser and continuing inbox work there.

plugins.name: Gmail
plugins.description: Search, read, draft, and manage email.
